Continuous Sign Language Recognition

Please read before continuing

  • This is a research preview, not a finished product.
  • Accuracy is much lower than our trained isolated-sign recognition.
  • Treat all outputs as suggestions, not corrections.
  • This surface does not score or judge your signing.
  • All processing is on-device. No video is uploaded.

The model used here (CTC Transformer over landmark sequences) is trained on limited data and has a Word Error Rate above 50% on held-out signers. It is published for transparency and stakeholder feedback only.
